summary: Aermotor fire tower in Sequatchie County, Tennessee, also called Bennett or Signal Mountain; registered by NHLR in 2019. Build date and current condition not found.

facts.design: traditional Aermotor tower with a 7'x7' cab

events.note: Accepted by the National Historic Lookout Register on February 19, 2019 as US 1291, TN 32; nominated by Victoria Oliver
Register says the tower was open to visitors in 2017 but may not be any longer

notes_for_editor: Thin record. NHLR is the only substantive source and gives no build year. Two searches found no tower-specific history for Dunlap (only the Wikipedia city page and county history). The tnlandforms table layout is ambiguous, so the Bennett row is used only for name, county and elevation, not for status. The easternuslookouts Bennett page is a header only (BENNETT, Sequatchie County). The brief's standing status is not confirmed by a clean source, so no status fact is recorded. NHLR's 2017 open-to-visitors note is not confirmed for today. The Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers MPS on NPGallery was not read and may list the build date. Verification 2026-10-08: the story's causal 'because' link between the steps and the advice was removed; the advice and the steps point are now reported as the regional guide's words.
